question_text: A student is asked to identify the components of the Philippine national territory as defined by the 1987 Constitution. Which of the following correctly lists the components?

options.text: The Philippine archipelago, all other territories over which the Philippines has sovereignty or jurisdiction, and the terrestrial, fluvial, and aerial domains.
Only the islands that were part of the Philippines at the time of the 1898 Treaty of Paris.
The archipelago and the waters within the baselines, but not the airspace.
The land mass of Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, and the internal waters only.
